THE SOUND BEHIND THE MOMENT.

It starts with a moment at an event. The right people and the right story can carry it far beyond the room.

EDM Journal is a global electronic music PR and media company. We connect DJs, event organizers, photographers and videographers to create and share stories that bring the scene closer together.
